bounds.statement: No feasible solution serves more service minutes than service_minutes_max, nor more service minutes of priority-3 jobs than priority3_service_minutes_max. Both come from a capacity relaxation (a fractional knapsack over each job's service plus its cheapest incoming leg); they are upper limits, usually not attainable.
